records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text:
Spotify keeps personal data only as long as is necessary to provide the Spotify Service and for Spotify's legitimate and essential business purposes, such as maintaining service performance, making data-driven business decisions, complying with legal obligations, and resolving disputes [Spotify – 6. Data retention].

Retention periods vary based on the type of data:
*   **Data you remove:** You can request that Spotify delete certain personal data, and you can also delete some data directly within the Spotify Service, such as your profile picture [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   **Data that expires:** Some data, like personal data from search queries, is deleted after 90 days, subject to other retention rules [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   **Data until account deletion:** Spotify keeps some data, like your username and profile information, until your Spotify account is deleted. Streaming history is also kept for the life of an account to support personalized recommendations and retrospective playlists [Spotify – 6. Data retention]. When the account is deleted, this data is either deleted or de-identified [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   **Extended retention:** After an account is deleted, some data may be kept for a longer time for limited reasons, such as fulfilling legal or contractual obligations, government orders for investigations, or for litigation purposes. Data may also be kept for a limited time to ensure user safety or protect against harmful content [Spotify – 6. Data retention].
*   **Age Check Data:** This data is deleted immediately after the Age Check is finished [Spotify – 6. Data retention] [Spotify – 3. Personal data we collect about you].
cited_labels: [Spotify – 3. Personal data we collect about you]

records.question: Will Spotify give my money back if I cancel partway through a subscription period?
records.text: Generally, Spotify does not provide refunds or credits for partial subscription periods, unless it is specifically stated in the Terms [Spotify – Billing and cancellation].

records.question: Can I team up with other Spotify customers to sue the company as a group?
records.text: No, you and Spotify agree that each party may bring claims only in an individual capacity, and neither party may participate as a plaintiff, claimant, or class member in any class, collective, consolidated, private attorney general, or representative proceeding [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver].
cited_labels: [Spotify – Governing law, jurisdiction, class action waiver, and jury trial waiver]

records.question: How old do you need to be to open a Netflix account?
records.text: You must be at least 18 years of age to create a Netflix account [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service]. Alternatively, you must be at least 18 years of age or the age of majority in your country of residence to subscribe to the Netflix service [Netflix – Minors].

records.question: Can somebody who doesn't live with me use my Netflix plan?
records.text: Yes, in countries where the feature is available, you can authorize a person outside of your household to access the Netflix service under your subscription as an Extra Member [Netflix – 3. Extra Members]. You can also use the Netflix service as an Extra Member if you do not live in the same household as the Account Owner, provided the feature is available in your country [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service].

records.question: How long does Netflix hang on to my details?
records.text: Netflix may keep personal information as long as is necessary to fulfill purposes such as providing its service, administering and operating its business, researching and improving its services, sending marketing and informational messages, supporting advertisements, ensuring safety, security, and preventing fraud, and complying with the law and enforcing the Netflix Terms of Use [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information]. The retention period is based on factors like your relationship with Netflix, the type of personal information, legal obligations, and the need to defend or resolve current or expected legal claims [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information]. Netflix takes reasonable steps to securely destroy or de-identify personal information when it is no longer needed [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information]. For more information on personal information retention, you can refer to [help.netflix.com/node/126558](https://help.netflix.com/node/126558) [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information].

records.question: How long does Lyft store records of my past trips and payments?
records.text: Lyft retains transactional information, such as rides and payments, for a minimum of seven years to fulfill legitimate business functions like accounting for tax obligations [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information].
cited_labels: [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information]

records.question: Will Lyft charge me if I book a ride and never turn up?
records.text: Yes, Lyft may charge a fee if you fail to show up after requesting a ride [Lyft – Charges].

records.question: Can a 17 year old ride with Lyft?
records.text: Yes, a 17-year-old may be able to use the Lyft Platform for Rideshare Services if a parent or legal guardian creates a User account for them, provided certain requirements and restrictions are met [Lyft – Eligibility]. Additionally, Lyft may process the personal information of teen users between the ages of 13 and 17 [Lyft – Children's Data].

records.question: Is Lyft making money by selling my data?
records.text: Lyft states that they do not sell your personal information to third parties for money, and they do not act as a data broker [Lyft – How We Disclose Your Information].

records.question: What's the youngest age allowed on Discord?
records.text: By accessing Discord's services, you confirm you are at least 13 years old and meet the minimum age required by the laws in your country [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians].
cited_labels: [Discord – Age requirements and responsibility of parents and legal guardians]

records.question: Does Discord sell what it knows about me to advertisers?
records.text: Discord may provide limited information to advertising platforms to help them reach people who might like Discord's products and to measure the performance of ads shown on those platforms [Discord – How we disclose your information]. Additionally, Discord may receive information from advertisers and third-party data providers, such as demographic information and how you engage with other products and services outside of Discord [Discord – Information we receive from other sources].
cited_labels: [Discord – Information we receive from other sources]

records.question: What happens if a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once?
records.text: If 100 or more similar arbitration demands are submitted to NAM against Discord within a short time frame, this is considered a "Mass Filing," and the parties agree to administer the Mass Filing in batches of 100 demands per batch [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord].
cited_labels: [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]

records.question: Are kids allowed to have a Reddit account?
records.text: No one under 13 is allowed to use or access the Services [Reddit – 1. Your Access to the Services]. Children under the age of 13 are not permitted to create an account or use the Services [Reddit – Children].

records.question: What rights does Reddit get over the things I post?
records.text: Reddit may use any ideas, suggestions, and feedback you provide about Reddit or its Services without owing you compensation or obligation [Reddit – 5. Your Content]. Additionally, you agree that Reddit can remove metadata from your content and you waive any claims or assertions of moral rights or attribution regarding your content [Reddit – 5. Your Content]. Reddit also has the right to delete, deem your content ineligible for monetization, or remove your content at any time and for any reason, including if it violates the Terms, Reddit Rules, or other terms and policies [Reddit – 5. Your Content].

records.question: How long does Reddit hold on to my IP address?
records.text: Reddit will delete any IP addresses collected after 100 days, except for the IP address used to create your account [Reddit – What Information We Collect].

records.question: Is Zoom allowed to shut down a service I'm paying for?
records.text: Zoom may terminate, suspend, or disconnect your Services immediately and without prior notice if a failure to pay Charges continues for five (5) calendar days after the due date [3, 12.7 Termination or Suspension for Nonpayment]. Additionally, Zoom may immediately suspend your access to the Services or terminate the Agreement if you fail to comply with any provision of this Agreement or any referenced policies, guides, notices, or statements [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]. Zoom can also terminate the Agreement for any reason or no reason with thirty (30) business days' advance notice [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION].

records.question: How long does Coursera store my personal information?
records.text: If you request deletion of your Personal Data, Coursera will delete the data associated with your account, including your learner profile, course history, and any issued certificates or certifications [Coursera – Your Rights]. However, after deletion, Coursera may keep some limited Personal Data for lawful and legitimate reasons, which can change based on your location, such as fulfilling legal requirements [Coursera – Your Rights]. Additionally, residual information might remain in their databases, access logs, or other records, which may or may not contain your Personal Data [Coursera – Your Rights]. For biometric facial data generated by a third-party identity verification vendor, it is destroyed upon successful verification and no later than 2 years [Coursera – Personal Data third parties collect directly from you].
cited_labels: [Coursera – Personal Data third parties collect directly from you]

records.question: Could Coursera still have my data after I ask them to erase it?
records.text: After you request deletion of your Personal Data, Coursera may keep limited Personal Data for lawful and legitimate reasons, which can vary based on your location, such as fulfilling legal requirements [Coursera – Your Rights]. Additionally, residual information might remain in their databases, access logs, or other records, and this may or may not include your Personal Data [Coursera – Your Rights].

records.question: Can a teenager sign up for their own PayPal account?
records.text: To open a PayPal account, an individual must be at least 18 years old [Paypal – Opening an account]. If you are an individual, you must be at least 18 years old and have full legal capacity to enter into a contract to open a PayPal account and use the PayPal services [Paypal – Welcome to PayPal!].

records.question: How long does PayPal keep my information once I stop being a customer?
records.text:
Personal Information used for the ongoing relationship with PayPal is kept for the duration of that relationship plus 10 years, or for as long as required by applicable local law after the relationship ends, unless a longer retention period is permitted by law for reasons such as legal obligations, bankruptcy laws, AML obligations, litigation, investigations, audit, or compliance practices [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information].

Additionally, after closing your account, PayPal may retain your electronic money for the time reasonably required to protect PayPal and/or any third party against risks like reversals, fees, fines, penalties, and other liabilities [Paypal – Closing Your PayPal Account].

Even if you close your account, delete, or request deletion of Personal Information, PayPal may still need to keep some of it as permitted by applicable law to fulfill transactions, provide requested goods or services, comply with promises in the user agreement, detect and prevent illegal activity, protect legal rights, manage internal business processes related to your expectations, or comply with laws and governmental requirements [Paypal – Your rights].
cited_labels: [Paypal – How Long We Store Your Personal Information]

records.question: How much time do I have to get my money back from my bank for a PayPal SEPA debit?
records.text: You can claim a refund from your bank up to 8 weeks after the date the SEPA Direct Debit payment occurred, according to your bank's terms and conditions [Paypal – Your continuous permission for us to charge your funding sources].

records.question: If I close my Strava account, does my data actually go away?
records.text: After requesting account deletion, your personal information, including backups, is permanently and irreversibly deleted from Strava's systems, and your data, such as your account, activities, and leaderboard placement, cannot be restored [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]. However, it may take up to 45 days for your personal information and system logs to be deleted [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data] [Strava – Retention of Information]. Strava may keep some information to comply with the law or take other legally permitted actions [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data] [Strava – Retention of Information]. Additionally, content you shared directly with others, like photos or videos on other social media platforms, or content others may have copied, may remain available even after you delete your account or specific information from your profile [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data].
cited_labels: [Strava – Deleting Information and Accounts and Downloading Your Data]
